config.sub.worldgen.tooltip: Configure IC2 generation in the world.
config.worldgen.rubberTree.tooltip: Enable generation of rubber trees in the world.
config.worldgen.copperOre.tooltip: Enable generation of copper in the world.
config.worldgen.tinOre.tooltip: Enable generation of tin in the world.
config.worldgen.uraniumOre.tooltip: Enable generation of uranium in the world.
config.worldgen.leadOre.tooltip: Enable generation of Lead in the world.
config.worldgen.oreDensityFactor.tooltip: Factor scaling the IC2 ore generation quantity.
config.worldgen.treeDensityFactor.toolti: Factor scaling the IC2 tree generation quantity.
config.worldgen.retrogenCheckLimit.toolt: Maximum amount of chunks to check for retrogen viability each tick.\nRetrogen is the retroactive generation of terrain features, e.g. ores and trees.\nSet it to 0 to disable retrogen.
config.worldgen.retrogenUpdateLimit.tool: Maximum amount of chunks to process for retrogen each tick.\nValues exceeding retrogenCheckLimit are being truncated.
config.sub.protection.tooltip: Configure explosion power limits, logging of wrench actions and disabling the nuke
config.protection.wrenchLogging.tooltip: Enable logging of players when they remove a machine using a wrench.
config.protection.nukeExplosionPowerLimi: Maximum Explosion power of a nuke, where TNT is 4.
config.protection.reactorExplosionPowerL: Maximum explosion power of a nuclear reactor, where TNT is 4.
config.sub.generator.tooltip: Configure the output of EU generators.\nIncrease for a higher yield.
config.sub.heatgenerator.tooltip: Configure the output of HU generators.\nIncrease for a higher yield.
config.sub.kineticgenerator.tooltip: Configure the output of KU generators.\nIncrease for a higher yield.
config.sub.fluidconversion.tooltip: Configure the output of the Liquid Heat Exchanger for each fluid.\nIncrease for a higher yield.
config.sub.FluidReactor.tooltip: Configure the output of fluid reactors.\nIncrease for a higher output.
config.sub.SteamKineticGenerator.tooltip: Configure the lifetime of steam turbine rotors.
config.sub.steamgenerator.tooltip: Configuration options for the steam genereator
config.sub.calcification.tooltip: Configure the maximum calcification a steam generator can reach before breaking
config.balance.steamgenerator.calcificat: Maximum calcification limit, in mB of Water
config.sub.steamRepressurizer.tooltip: Configuration options for the steam repressurizer
config.balance.steamRepressurizer.steamP: Amount (in mb) of standard steam per 10mb of IC2 steam
Amount (in mb) of standard steam per 10mb of IC2 super-heated steam
config.balance.fermenter.need_amount_bio: Amount of biomass needed per operation
config.balance.fermenter.output_amount_b: Amount of biogas produced per operation
config.balance.fermenter.biomass_per_fer: Biomass needed for each fertilizer produced
config.sub.predefined.tooltip: Fixed values of UU that everything else is calculated from
config.balance.minerDischargeTier.toolti: Maximum battery tier usable by the miner.
config.balance.teleporterUseInventoryWei: Increase the energy use by the player's inventory weight when going through a teleporter.
config.balance.energyRetainedInStorageBl: Ratio of energy retained inside energy storage blocks when wrenched.
config.balance.uuEnergyFactor.tooltip: Factor to scale the UU-Matter production energy requirement.
config.balance.disableEnderChest.tooltip: Disable the vanilla ender chest, removing existing ones from the world as well.
config.balance.recyclerBlacklist.tooltip: List of blocks and items which should not be turned into scrap by the recycler.
config.balance.recyclerWhitelist.tooltip: Whitelist for blocks/items allowed to be recycled.\nThe whitelist will be used instead of the blacklist approach if it's non-empty, disallowing everything else.
config.balance.ignoreWrenchRequirement.t: Allow to pick blocks up using just a pickaxe instead of needing a wrench.
config.balance.watermillAutomation.toolt: Allow the water slot of water mills to be automated.
config.sub.recipes.tooltip: Configure IC2's recipes and other recipe related things.
config.recipes.disable.tooltip: Disable IC2 crafting recipes with the specified output.
config.recipes.purge.tooltip: Purge crafting recipes with the specified output, including vanilla and mod ones.
config.recipes.allowCoinCrafting.tooltip: Enable crafting of IC2 coins, otherwise they have to be spawned in and are thus limited.
config.recipes.requireIc2Circuits.toolti: Allow only IC2 circuits to be used in IC2's recipes.
config.recipes.smeltToIc2Items.tooltip: Adjust smelting recipes to always output IC2 items if available.
config.misc.maxAudioSourceCount.tooltip: Maximum number of active audio sources, only change it if you know what you're doing.
config.misc.quantumSpeedOnSprint.tooltip: Enable activation of the quantum leggings' speed boost when sprinting instead of holding the boost key.
config.misc.allowBurningScrap.tooltip: Enable burning of scrap in a generator.
config.misc.additionalValuableOres.toolt: Additional ores the miner should harvest.
config.misc.useLinearTransferModel.toolt: Use the new highly experimental current + voltage energy net model with energy loss.
config.sub.debug.tooltip: Additional logging options for resolving issues
config.debug.logEmptyWrenchDrops.tooltip: Log whenever wrenching something didn't produce any drops.
config.debug.logIncorrectItemDamaging.to: Log incorrect damage applications to items that aren't supposed to ever take damage.
config.debug.logGridUpdateIssues.tooltip: Log problems occurring when processing connectivity updates in the energy network.
config.debug.logGridUpdatesVerbose.toolt: Log all energy net connectivity updates in detail.
config.debug.logGridCalculationIssues.to: Log problems occurring during energy network calculations.
